title: Transcriptome Annotation Protocol
author: Bing Cheng; Agnelo Furtado; Robert Henry
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ja4cigw
materials: E-value set at 1e-10. Use of HPC.
E-value set at 1e-20. Use of HPC.

steps.title: Download Plant GI List
steps.instruction: Download the plant geninfo identifier (GI) list from NCBI Protein Entrez.

steps.title: Retrieve Plant Proteins
steps.instruction: Download the NCBI non-redundant proteins from the NCBI FTP site and retrieve the plant proteins using the plant GI list via high performance computers (HPC).

steps.title: Perform BLASTn Search
steps.instruction: Submit sequences that had no hits to nr-plant to BLASTn against the nt database using HPC.

steps.title: Filter and Cluster BLAST Results
steps.instruction: Filter the BLAST results based on query coverage, cumulative identity, and sequence length using HPC, then cluster them into high, medium, and low quality.

substeps.instruction: Use the filtering script available at https://github.com/chengbing0404/BLAST5_result_handle

steps.title: Perform Functional Annotation
steps.instruction: Use BLAST2GO software to load InterProScan, mapping, annotation, annex, GO-Slim, and KEGG pathway data.

steps.title: Search for Non-coding RNAs
steps.instruction: For sequences without hits to any of the above databases, run Rfam from BLAST2GO to search for non-coding RNAs.
